intent: FOH owner foh-hev-kit-20261029; reply macbook/foh-hev. Adam opened his kit dashboard after the summary-guard rollout (main 3618f03) on 2026-10-30 and still sees many missing summaries. Live repair over the last 30 days (5,880 sessions) left about 2,350 blank. FOH sampled the blanks and found three causes. Fix all three. Base is kit main; keep every existing guard rule and test (rules a-d, probe tables). Work only in this kit clone, commit your candidate. Do not push, merge, deploy, write to any live namespace, resolve credentials, spawn workers or accept your own work. Report: what changed, tests and output, candidate commit. CAUSE 1 (about 25% of blanks): the repair (cmd/hev backfill --summaries, summarizeArchiveSession/claudeSummaryBatch) only looks at the session row's FirstPrompt. Older Codex rows store the AGENTS.md block as FirstPrompt, so RequestText leaves nothing useful even though the session has many later user prompts (e.g. 38 prompts, 648 tools). Fix: when RequestText(FirstPrompt) is empty or yields no usable request, read that session's archived user text chunks (role=user, block_type=text, ordered by seq) from the chunks namespace the dashboard already reads, apply RequestText to each, and use the first non-empty one; fall back to concatenating the first few non-empty ones up to the 1,000-char cap. Batch the chunk reads (one query per page of sessions, filtered by session_id In [...]) so a page of 40 does not make 40 calls. CAUSE 2 (about 65%): Haiku returns task_present=false for automated agent prompts that start with a role, e.g. 'You are the sous chef making one bounded delivery decision...', 'You are the gaffer for job x6rucn ... coordinate this job', 'Begin a fresh shift... You are the BOH Expediter', 'Run one iteration of the @hevmind X loop'. These are real tasks. Fix the summarizer prompt: a role or persona plus a job to do is a task; task_present=false only when the input is purely harness-injected context (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instruction text, environment_context, permission/sandbox text) with no job. Summaries should name the job, e.g. 'Sous chef delivery decision for oven-84'. CAUSE 3 (about 900 rows): claudeSummaryBatch sends 40 sessions in one claude -p call with a 90s timeout; any timeout or count mismatch blanks all 40. Fix: batches of at most 10, timeout 180s, one retry per failed batch, and a failed batch only affects its own rows.
